From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Great meeting at FinEdge Summit — follow-up on inference needs

Hi Samantha —

Really enjoyed our conversation at the FinEdge Summit today. Thanks for taking a few minutes to walk through FinEdge's recommendation flow and the latency/cost pressures you mentioned for peak trading hours. Quick recap from my side:

- Current pain: recommendations infra has 150–300ms tail latency spikes during peak, and ops wants tighter cost predictability for Q1 budget planning.
- Primary goals you mentioned: 1) consistent sub-100ms recommendations for online use-cases, 2) private deployment (VPC) for sensitive user data, 3) predictable monthly costs with reserved capacity for peak windows.

I think Redwood's Dedicated offering + prefix/KV caching could give a clear path to reducing tail latency while keeping unit costs under control. Happy to put Dylan (cc'd) on a quick discovery call next week to understand traffic patterns and key success metrics.

Suggested next steps:
1) 30-min discovery with Dylan + Marcus (solutions) — link to my calendar here: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min
2) We’ll send a short pre-read (SLA/arch overview + SOC2 snapshot) so your security team can triage.
3) If aligned, we can provide a cost/throughput estimate and a short PO-ready SOW template.

Attaching the deck I shared at the summit: redwood-finedge-summit-deck.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124

Redwood Inference — production-grade LLM inference (Hosted | Dedicated | Private)

Thanks for the follow-up and the deck — looks useful. I can do a 30-min call next week; how is Wednesday 10/7 at 10am PT? A couple quick items so Dylan can scope:

Subject: Re: Great meeting at FinEdge Summit — discovery recap & mutual action plan

Hi Samantha —

Great to meet quickly this morning — appreciate the context. Below is a concise post-call recap and proposed mutual action plan.

Call notes / qualification highlights:
- Primary product line: realtime recommendations for retail trading UX.
- Traffic: p95 ~ 120ms, p99 spikes to 250–300ms during market open; peak QPS ~ 450.
- Security: SOC2 required; US-only data residency for this product.
- Budget: looking to lock a commit for Q1 usage; procurement target EoNov.

Mutual action plan (proposed):
1) Redwood deliverables (this week): SOC2 snapshot + short architecture note for Private/VPC options (attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf).
2) FinEdge deliverables (by 10/14): anonymized traffic profile (sample logs) and list of compliance contacts.
3) Technical deep-dive + demo (45 min) with Marcus and your infra team — proposed: 10/13 or 10/14. Marcus will demo Dedicated behavior, caching, and a cost/throughput baseline.
4) Commercial: we’ll send a draft SOW and a ballpark cost estimate for a Dedicated reserved capacity profile after the deep-dive. SOW template attached: redwood-sow-template.docx

Open questions we flagged:
- Exact SLAs you need for p99 during market open.
- Any special encryption/KMS requirements for key custody.

I’ll send calendar invites for the demo once you confirm availability. If you want a written estimate earlier, we can do a quick modeling exercise from the sample traffic.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124
